capabilities: render clock widgets with configurable time format
display quote widgets with author attribution
insert countdown widgets from absolute or relative dates
track incrementable counters with reset and per-note ids
open widgets as persistent workspace views via the command palette
extras: Widget styling cannot be customized via options; the README points to CSS snippets for custom looks. Counter values are stored in the .obsidian/plugins folder, so syncing counts across devices requires syncing that folder.
problem: Obsidian notes are static Markdown and have no built-in way to embed live or interactive elements like clocks, countdowns, or counters.
summary: Widget renderer that displays clock, quote, countdown, and interactive counter widgets in notes via special code blocks.
